01 / Meet Subaru

Experience built on care.

Subaru moved to the United States from Japan in 2013 after practicing acupuncture and Shiatsu massage there. She graduated from Hanada College — the Japan School of Acupuncture, Moxibustion, and Physiotherapy — in Tokyo in 2000, then spent ten years running her own acupuncture clinic.

Trained in Japanese,
Chinese, and American styles.

02 / The care she offers

A practice with depth.

Personalized acupuncture care for chronic pain, nervous system support, and everyday wellbeing.

01

Japanese acupuncture

Gentle, precise treatment informed by touch-based diagnosis and Subaru’s original training in Tokyo.

02

Moxibustion

A warming technique using moxa to complement acupuncture and bring focused care to specific points.

03

Fire cupping

A traditional complementary treatment often used for muscle tightness, sprains, and recovery.
